package com.acme.billing.v2.internal;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Internal (v2) billing maths. Not part of the public API.
 */
public class BillingCalculator {

	private static final BigDecimal GST_RATE = new BigDecimal("0.09");

	public BigDecimal subtotal(final List<BigDecimal> lineAmounts) {
		BigDecimal sum = BigDecimal.ZERO;
		for (BigDecimal amount : lineAmounts) {
			sum = sum.add(amount);
		}
		return sum;
	}

	public BigDecimal gst(final BigDecimal subtotal) {
		return subtotal.multiply(GST_RATE).setScale(2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
	}

	public BigDecimal total(final BigDecimal... lineAmounts) {
		final BigDecimal subtotal = subtotal(List.of(lineAmounts));
		return subtotal.add(gst(subtotal));
	}
}
